entries.name: workflow-verify-before-approval
entries.claim: A definition verified after approval never enters guest replay.

entries.name: workflow-revoked-automation-grant
entries.claim: A workflow write leaves no semantic operation receipt after the automation actor loses its current grant.

kills.name: R3 a workflow write cannot outlive the automation actor’s grants
kills.expected: an actor without a current grant must leave no committed operation receipt

entries.name: workflow-substituted-receipt-scope
entries.claim: Dispatch and the committed write use the scope of the source receipt event.

kills.name: dispatch derives company and receipt from the source event
kills.expected: worker instance operands must not change the dispatched company or written receipt

entries.name: workflow-stalled-replay-release-lock
entries.claim: A stalled workflow replay holds no release pointer lock during activation or rollback.

kills.expected: activation and rollback must complete before workflow replay resumes
